newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA DELAYS RULING ON MINERALBANK INSOLVENCY.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA DELAYS RULING ON MINERALBANK INSOLVENCY.

text.p: The Sofia City court on Tuesday again postponed ruling on an insolvency suit against state-owned Mineralbank until March and ordered an additional report on its financial condition, a bank official said.
"The court sought further clarification on the bank's financial status and postponed the case until March 19," the official told reporters.
Mineralbank was placed in receivership by the central bank on May 17 due to a danger of insolvency. The suit was filed two weeks later.
The court has three times delayed ruling on the case since then, citing lack of sufficient information on the bank's assets and liabilities at the moment when the central bank filed the suit.
